content:
eli: quick sync re: breaking header rename with CloudVendorX marketplace image. CloudVendorX CI verifies package manifests strictly. if we change `Auth-Token` -> `RW-Auth` and push a manifest update some partners will get install fails.

sasha: ouch. can we do a dual-accept mode on the runtime for a transition window? runtime would accept both headers but emit deprecation warnings to telemetry.

toni: dual-accept seems safest. question: how do we avoid partners keeping the old header forever? need an end-date policy.

eli: propose 'sunset tag' in marketplace metadata: `sunset-by=YYYY-MM-DD`. installers that check manifest will warn if current date past `sunset-by`. we also put soft warnings in partner dashboard.

build-bot: CI: added check - manifests without `sunset-by` fail partner bundle submit (rule id: M-208).

partner-relations-bot: created comms draft: "We're planning to rename the `Auth-Token` header to `RW-Auth`. Dual-accept will be available for 60 days; after that old header will start returning 400s. Request extensions here: https://support.redwood/compat-extensions"

sasha: timeline: SDK patch with compatibility parsing + telemetry in 2 weeks, marketplace metadata change this week, partner announcement next Tuesday.

toni: also flagging SI customers with on-prem. they might need a 90-day window. recommend manual extension flow via ticket.

eli: ok will include extension form. assigning followups: SDK (toni), marketplace metadata (sasha), comms (eli).
